## What I shaped

It also answers F4, regenerates `benchmark/results/challenges.json` and updates every pin of each file it changes. Its first step is a tool probe; if Read or Grep fails, it reports the exact error and stops.

I did not read the researcher probe report (#843). The task bodies come from record 0195 with new ids and pin file names. Expected gain: #828 F2 and F4 close, and a CLEAR closes the positive-control thread.
